title: Mhairie Sioux Escrivain and the Dracula of Hogwarts
author: Roger Carbol  (as M Grablowsky)
description: You were just a regular girl living a regular life in North Dakota when a letter arrived that changed your life.  You had been accepted as an exchange student to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, all the way in England!  You packed your bags and left without delay.  After a plane, a train, and a boat, you now sit in the Great Hall of Hogwarts itself.
